title: Playing with Sweet Emma and Celestin
summary: Ferbos played with Emma off and on, took calls by phone from anybody, and played with Celestin when Kildee and Ormond Franklin were in the band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What about Emma? You told me about her. You told me about her.

Oh yeah, I played with Emma off and on, a good many years ago too. But like I said, maybe that was about, I guess about two years or so ago I played one game with her. But other than that it would have been years ago I used to play with her.
No, not steady, just about, yeah. In fact those offers that I mentioned to you, those are the ones I could study with, but

I would be in my house and the phone would ring, or in fact I didn't have a phone, you would ring my neighbor's phone, or so it would call or somebody would drop it off and say, are you working tonight? And I'd say no, come and work with us.
And it didn't make any difference who it was. Because it made that nice of a day. Gig and Spartan.
So you played with everybody just to know that. Right. Did you play much with Celestan? I played with Celestan a while.

I played with Celestan when Kildee and Ormond Franklin was in the band. Celestan stopped playing for a while. And I was the other man and he was directing, he would like to take care of the band in the front. I worked with P. Rowan's band even from time to time. It's in the days of the evening too.
